name: Dreams Plum True
ingredients: Bombay Sapphire gin, plum, ginger, sage, lemon, egg white, plum bitters

recipe.item: plum syrup (or 1/2 oz plum purée + 1/4 oz simple syrup)
ginger syrup (or 1 barspoon fresh ginger juice)
plum bitters (Fee Brothers, or berry bitters)

method: If you need plum syrup, simmer 1/2 cup chopped ripe plum with 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water for about 8 minutes (add 3 slices of ginger for the last 3 minutes if you don't have ginger syrup), then strain and cool.
Dry-shake gin, lemon, plum syrup, ginger syrup, sage leaves, plum bitters, and egg white for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A sage leaf, and a thin plum slice if you have one

name: Sword Coast Special
ingredients: End of Days barrel-rested rum, Sandeman ruby port, Amaro Averna, orange, lime, cinnamon, vanilla, Angostura bitters, orange bitters
notes: Any good barrel-aged rum stands in for End of Days.

recipe.item: barrel-aged rum (End of Days, or any barrel-rested rum)

method: Make a quick cinnamon-vanilla syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 2 cinnamon sticks for 5 minutes; stir in 1/2 tsp vanilla off the heat, then cool and strain.
Shake rum, ruby port, Averna, orange, lime, syrup, and both bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Orange twist and a cinnamon stick

name: Whiskey Powers
ingredients: Maker's Mark bourbon, jalapeño agave, lime, cinnamon, vanilla, egg white
notes: Made at home. Elijah Craig works too.
method: Make the jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup (see the Calculator tab): simmer 1/2 cup agave, 1/2 cup water, 1 sliced jalapeño, and 2 cinnamon sticks; stir in 1/2 tsp vanilla off the heat, then cool and strain. About 8 oz per batch.
Dry-shake bourbon, lime, syrup, and egg white for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Lime wheel, jalapeño slice, or a dusting of cinnamon

name: Pomfoolery
ingredients: Lunazul tequila, Domaine de Canton, pomegranate, champagne, lemon, smoked rosemary
notes: To smoke the rosemary, torch a sprig until it smolders and rest it on the glass.
method: Shake tequila, Domaine de Canton, pomegranate juice, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Top with champagne.
Torch a rosemary sprig until it smokes and rest it on the glass.
garnish: Smoked rosemary sprig

name: Envy
ingredients: Tito's vodka, Malibu coconut rum, amaretto, lemon, pandan
method: Make pandan syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 8 pandan leaves for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. If you can't find leaves, stir 1/8 tsp pandan extract into 1/2 cup cooled simple syrup.
Shake vodka, Malibu, amaretto, lemon, and pandan syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
garnish: Lemon wheel or a short pandan leaf

name: Jalapeño Margarita
ingredients: Lunazul blanco tequila, jalapeño agave, lime, Tajín rim
notes: Uses the same jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup as the Whiskey Powers.
method: Use the same jalapeño-cinnamon-vanilla agave syrup as the Whiskey Powers (see the Calculator tab).
Rim a rocks glass with lime and Tajín.
Shake tequila, lime, and syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in the rimmed rocks glass.
garnish: Tajín rim, plus a lime wheel or jalapeño slice

name: Strawberry Stick & Poke
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, Frangelico, Kahlúa, strawberry, hand-whipped cream

recipe.item: ripe strawberries, muddled (or 3/4 oz strawberry purée)
simple syrup (skip if using sweetened purée)
heavy cream, hand-whipped to a soft float

method: Muddle the strawberries with the simple syrup in a shaker (or start with strawberry purée and skip the extra syrup if it's already sweet).
Add vodka, Frangelico, and Kahlúa; shake with ice for 15 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Softly whip the cold cream to a pourable ribbon and float it on top.
garnish: A strawberry half, or a light dusting of cocoa

name: Ambrosia
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, ChocoLat, crème de cacao, Kahlúa, heavy cream, chocolate bitters
notes: ChocoLat is a chocolate liqueur; Godiva, Mozart, or another chocolate liqueur works.
method: Shake vodka, ChocoLat, crème de cacao, Kahlúa, cream, and chocolate bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Shaved chocolate, or a few extra drops of chocolate bitters on the cream

name: Campfire Coffee
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, crème de cacao, Baileys, hot coffee, toasted marshmallow
method: Add vodka, crème de cacao, and Baileys to a pre-warmed mug.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Toast a marshmallow over a flame until browned and perch it on the rim, or float it on the drink.
garnish: Toasted marshmallow

name: Peppermint Bark Martini
ingredients: Stoli vanilla vodka, Rumple Minze peppermint liqueur, Mozart chocolate liqueur, crème de cacao, heavy cream
notes: Rumple Minze is intense; keep it at 1/2 oz so the chocolate can keep up.
method: Shake vodka, Rumple Minze, Mozart chocolate liqueur, crème de cacao, and cream with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
garnish: Shaved chocolate or a pinch of crushed peppermint

name: Espresso Martini
ingredients: Vodka, coffee liqueur (usually Kahlúa), espresso or cold brew concentrate, simple syrup

recipe.item: freshly brewed espresso (or cold brew concentrate)

method: Shake vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso, and simple syrup hard with ice for 15 seconds, until well chilled and foamy.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.
garnish: 3 coffee beans

name: Paper Plane
ingredients: Bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino Quintessentia, fresh lemon juice
notes: The name wasn't on the screenshot; this equal-parts spec is the Paper Plane.
method: Shake bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: None, or a thin lemon twist

name: Naked and Famous
ingredients: Mezcal (preferably Del Maguey Chichicapa), Aperol, yellow Chartreuse, fresh lime juice
method: Shake mezcal, Aperol, yellow Chartreuse, and lime with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: None, or a lime twist

name: Bourbon Pumpkin Smash
ingredients: Spiced pumpkin syrup, bourbon or whiskey, orange or clementine juice, orange bitters, ginger beer (optional)
notes: Batch for 4: 1 1/2 cups bourbon, 1/2 cup orange juice, 6–8 dashes orange bitters, and 4 ginger beers, plus the full syrup recipe below (use 1–2 oz syrup per drink to taste).
method: Make the spiced pumpkin syrup: simmer 1/2 cup maple syrup, 1/3 cup water, 1/3 cup pumpkin purée, 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp vanilla, and a pinch of sea salt for about 5 minutes, then cool.
Shake bourbon, 1 1/2 oz syrup (use 1–2 oz to taste), orange juice, and bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Pour over ice in a rocks glass and top with ginger beer if you like.
garnish: An orange slice, or a dusting of pumpkin pie spice

name: Pay the Piper
ingredients: Rye, St. Germain, pear, rosemary, ginger, lemon, hard cider
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.

recipe.item: rosemary sprig, for the shake and garnish

method: If you need ginger syrup, simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 1/4 cup sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.
Shake rye, St. Germain, pear, lemon, ginger syrup, and a rosemary sprig with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice and top with hard cider.
Garnish with a fresh rosemary sprig.
garnish: Rosemary sprig

name: Almost Famous
ingredients: Mezcal, Aperol, passionfruit, honey, lime
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: If you need honey syrup, stir equal parts honey and hot water until smooth, then cool.
Shake mezcal, Aperol, passionfruit, lime, and honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A lime wheel, or a little passionfruit pulp

name: Accidentally in Love
ingredients: Gin, green Chartreuse, lemon, honey, pistachio
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Make a quick pistachio syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 1/4 cup chopped pistachios for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Orgeat is a decent stand-in.
Shake gin, green Chartreuse, lemon, honey syrup, and pistachio syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Crushed pistachios on the foam, or a lemon twist

name: Off the Beeten Path
ingredients: Gin, Cynar, Domaine de Canton, Ancho Reyes, beet, honey, lemon
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake gin, Cynar, Domaine de Canton, Ancho Reyes, beet, honey syrup, and lemon with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A lemon twist

name: Raising Canes
ingredients: Rum, cinnamon-apple infused vermouth, Averna, grapefruit, lemon, Angostura
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. If you don't have cinnamon-apple infused vermouth, use 3/4 oz sweet vermouth plus 1/4 oz apple cider and a pinch of cinnamon, or a barspoon of cinnamon syrup.
method: If you need a stand-in for the infused vermouth, stir 3/4 oz sweet vermouth with 1/4 oz apple cider and a pinch of cinnamon (or a barspoon of cinnamon syrup).
Shake rum, vermouth, Averna, grapefruit, lemon, and Angostura with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A grapefruit twist

name: Get Off My Lawn
ingredients: Tequila, orange liqueur, ancho pepper, cumin, lime, Tajín
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Rim a rocks glass with lime, then Tajín mixed with a pinch of cumin.
Shake tequila, orange liqueur, Ancho Reyes, lime, and a pinch of cumin with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in the rimmed rocks glass.
garnish: Tajín-cumin rim and a lime wheel

name: Smoked Old Fashioned
ingredients: Bourbon, sorghum molasses, Angostura, orange, cherry-wood smoke
source: The Gamekeeper Restaurant specialty cocktails menu
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. If you don't have sorghum molasses, use a barspoon of maple syrup or rich demerara syrup.
method: Stir bourbon, sorghum molasses, and Angostura with ice until well chilled.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the drink and drop it in.
Smoke the glass or the finished drink with cherry wood — a smoking gun, or invert the glass over a lit cherry-wood chip for a few seconds, then pour.
garnish: Expressed orange peel and cherry-wood smoke

name: Aperol Spritz
ingredients: Aperol, prosecco, orange slice
notes: Home recipe. The classic build also uses a splash of soda; skip it if you want it richer.
method: Fill a highball or wine glass with ice.
Add prosecco, then Aperol, then a splash of soda, and give it a gentle stir.
garnish: An orange slice

name: Mojito
ingredients: Muddled lime, fresh mint, simple syrup, white rum, seltzer
notes: Home recipe.

recipe.item: fresh lime juice (or 1/2 lime, cut into wedges)

method: Gently muddle the mint with the syrup and lime in a shaker (don't shred the leaves).
Add the rum and ice, and shake for 10 seconds.
Pour into a highball over fresh ice and top with seltzer.
Give it a light stir.
garnish: A mint sprig and a lime wheel

name: Feeling Peachy
ingredients: Basil Hayden bourbon, peach schnapps, bitters, muddled cherry and orange
notes: Home recipe.
method: Muddle the orange slice and cherries in a shaker.
Add bourbon, peach schnapps, and bitters; shake with ice for 10 seconds.
Pour over ice in a rocks glass.
garnish: A cherry and an orange slice

name: Old Fashioned
ingredients: George Dickel 8 Year, simple syrup, Angostura bitters, orange bitters
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Stir the whiskey, simple syrup, and both bitters with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Orange twist

name: Manhattan
ingredients: High West rye, Carpano Antica, orange bitters, Angostura bitters
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Served up.
method: Stir the rye, Carpano Antica, and both bitters with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Brandied cherry, or an orange twist

name: Whiskey Sour
ingredients: Basil Hayden, lemon juice, simple syrup, egg white, Angostura bitters
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Dry-shake the bourbon, lemon, simple syrup, and egg white for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Dot the foam with Angostura bitters and drag a toothpick through for a simple design, if you like.
garnish: Angostura drops on the foam, or a lemon wheel

name: Bobby Burns
ingredients: Dewar's 12 Year, Carpano Antica, Bénédictine, Peychaud's bitters
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Stir the Scotch, Carpano Antica, Bénédictine, and Peychaud's with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Lemon twist

name: Brown Derby
ingredients: George Dickel 8 Year, grapefruit juice, honey
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Honey syrup is 1:1 honey and warm water, stirred until dissolved.
method: Shake the whiskey, grapefruit juice, and honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Grapefruit twist

name: Scofflaw
ingredients: Bulleit Rye, dry vermouth, grenadine, lemon juice
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake the rye, dry vermouth, lemon juice, and grenadine with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Lemon twist

name: Lion's Tale
ingredients: Woodford Reserve, allspice dram, orange juice, lemon juice, honey
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. This is a Lion's Tail built with the menu's orange, lemon, and honey (the usual classic uses lime and simple syrup). Honey syrup is 1:1 honey and warm water.
method: Shake the bourbon, allspice dram, orange juice, lemon juice, and honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Orange twist, or a dusting of grated nutmeg

name: Sidecar
ingredients: Courvoisier, Cointreau, lemon juice, sugar rim
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Rim a chilled coupe with sugar (run a lemon wedge around the edge, then dip in sugar).
Shake the cognac, Cointreau, and lemon juice with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the rimmed coupe.
garnish: Sugar rim, and a lemon twist if you like

name: Sazerac
ingredients: Rémy Martin, Sazerac Rye, simple syrup, Peychaud's bitters
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu lists both Rémy Martin and Sazerac Rye, so this is a split-base classic. An absinthe or Herbsaint rinse is traditional even if it wasn't printed on the menu.
method: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe or Herbsaint and discard the excess (skip only if you don't have it).
Stir the rye, cognac, simple syrup, and Peychaud's with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain into the rinsed glass, with no ice.
garnish: Lemon twist, expressed over the drink and dropped in or perched on the rim

name: Suffering Bastard
ingredients: Rémy Martin, Tanqueray, lime juice, simple syrup, Angostura bitters, ginger beer
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake the cognac, gin, lime juice, simple syrup, and Angostura with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
Top with ginger beer and give it a light stir.
garnish: Mint sprig and a lime wheel

name: Vieux Carré
ingredients: Hennessy, Dickel rye, Bénédictine, Carpano Antica
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Peychaud's and Angostura are traditional in a Vieux Carré even if they weren't listed on the menu.
method: Stir the cognac, rye, Carpano Antica, Bénédictine, and both bitters with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Lemon twist, or a brandied cherry

name: Mojito
ingredients: Bacardi, lime juice, mint, simple syrup, club soda
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Gently muddle the mint with the lime juice and simple syrup in a shaker (don't shred the leaves).
Add the rum and ice, and shake briefly.
Pour into a highball over fresh ice and top with club soda.
Give it a light stir.
garnish: A mint sprig and a lime wheel

name: Daiquiri
ingredients: Bacardi, lime juice, simple syrup
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake the rum, lime juice, and simple syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Lime wheel, or no garnish

name: Dark & Stormy
ingredients: Gosling's rum, lime juice, simple syrup, Fever-Tree ginger beer
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. A traditional Dark 'n' Stormy is Gosling's Black Seal and ginger beer; the lime and simple here follow the menu.
method: Build the rum, lime juice, and simple syrup in a highball over ice.
Top with Fever-Tree ginger beer and give it a light stir.
garnish: Lime wheel or wedge

name: Members Only
ingredients: Urban Oak private selection Buffalo Trace, Aperol, strawberry, lime, rhubarb bitters
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The bar uses an Urban Oak private-selection Buffalo Trace; regular Buffalo Trace works at home.

recipe.item: Buffalo Trace bourbon (Urban Oak private selection, or regular Buffalo Trace)
strawberry syrup (or 3 muddled strawberries + 1/4 oz simple syrup)

method: If you need strawberry syrup, simmer 1 cup chopped strawberries with 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water for about 8 minutes, then strain and cool.
Shake the bourbon, Aperol, strawberry syrup, lime, and rhubarb bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A strawberry slice, or a thin lime wheel

name: Thyme Warp
ingredients: Gray Whale gin, Italicus, thyme, lemon, Angostura bitters, pink peppercorn, aquafaba
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Aquafaba is the liquid from a can of chickpeas; 3/4 oz stands in for one egg white.
method: Make thyme syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 6 thyme sprigs for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. If you're in a hurry, skip the syrup and clap 3 thyme sprigs in the shaker with 1/2 oz simple syrup instead.
Dry-shake the gin, Italicus, thyme syrup, lemon, Angostura, cracked pink peppercorns, and aquafaba for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A thyme sprig and a few cracked pink peppercorns

name: Espresso Yourself
ingredients: Wheatley vodka, espresso, Borghetti, vanilla, lemon zest
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Borghetti is an espresso liqueur; another coffee liqueur works if that's what you have.
method: Make vanilla syrup by stirring 1/2 tsp vanilla extract into 1/2 cup simple syrup (or simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with a split vanilla bean, then cool and strain).
Shake the vodka, espresso, Borghetti, and vanilla syrup hard with ice for 15 seconds, until frothy.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: Lemon zest, expressed over the foam

name: The Final Word Is Yours
ingredients: Mezcal or gin, Luxardo maraschino, Faccia Brutto Centerbe, lime
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu lets you choose mezcal or gin; this equal-parts Last Word riff works with either. Faccia Brutto Centerbe stands in for the herbal Chartreuse role.
method: Shake the mezcal or gin, Luxardo, Centerbe, and lime with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A lime twist, or a brandied cherry

name: Not Your Basic B****
ingredients: Vanilla vodka, Banane du Brésil, lemon, green cardamom bitters
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Shake the vanilla vodka, Banane du Brésil, lemon, and cardamom bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A thin banana chip or slice, or a lemon twist

name: Millions of Peaches
ingredients: Pinot grigio, pisco, Giffard Pêche, peach, orange, lemon, Fever-Tree ginger beer, peach bitters
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: If you need peach syrup, simmer 1 cup chopped ripe peach with 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water for about 8 minutes, then strain and cool. Peach purée also works.
Shake the pinot grigio, pisco, Giffard Pêche, peach purée or syrup, orange, lemon, and peach bitters with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice, top with Fever-Tree ginger beer, and give it a light stir.
garnish: A peach slice or an orange wheel

name: Play With Fire (Old Fashioned)
ingredients: Elijah Craig, serrano hot honey, tiki bitters, orange zest
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. RK already keeps Elijah Craig at home. Serrano hot honey: gently warm 1/2 cup honey with 1 sliced serrano (seeds in for more heat) for 5 minutes, steep 10 minutes off the heat, then strain. Thin with a splash of hot water if it's too thick to pour.
method: Make the serrano hot honey (see notes) and let it cool.
Stir the bourbon, serrano hot honey, and tiki bitters with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Orange zest, expressed over the drink

name: Mezspressogroni
ingredients: Banhez mezcal, Campari, Borghetti, Cocchi Torino, orange zest
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. A mezcal Negroni with a little espresso liqueur. Borghetti is an espresso liqueur; Cocchi Torino is sweet vermouth (Cocchi Vermouth di Torino).
method: Stir the mezcal, Campari, Cocchi Torino, and Borghetti with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
garnish: Orange zest, expressed over the drink

name: Tastes Like Beach
ingredients: Planteray coconut rum, Strega, cinnamon, pineapple, lime, tiki bitters, Angostura bitters, mint
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Planteray is the current name for Plantation rum.
method: Make cinnamon syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, and 2 cinnamon sticks for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.
Shake the rum, Strega, cinnamon syrup, pineapple, lime, and both bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
garnish: A mint sprig and a pineapple or lime wedge

name: Pinky's Up
ingredients: Lyre's Pink gin, strawberry, vanilla, habanero agave, lemon, aquafaba
source: Bar menu photo, Urban Oak originals
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. A spirit-free / mocktail. Lyre's Pink London Spirit is the non-alcoholic pink gin; aquafaba (chickpea liquid) stands in for egg white.

recipe.item: Lyre's Pink London Spirit (non-alcoholic pink gin)

method: Strawberry syrup: simmer 1 cup chopped strawberries with 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water for about 8 minutes, then strain and cool.
Vanilla syrup: stir 1/2 tsp vanilla extract into 1/2 cup simple syrup.
Habanero agave: simmer 1/2 cup agave, 1/2 cup water, and 1/2 sliced habanero (seeds in for more heat) for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Start with half a pepper — it's hot.
Dry-shake the Lyre's, strawberry syrup, vanilla syrup, habanero agave, lemon, and aquafaba for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake 15 seconds more.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A strawberry slice, or a thin lemon wheel

name: Sidecar
ingredients: Courvoisier VS, Grand Marnier, lemon juice, orange peel, sugar rim
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. This bar's Sidecar uses Courvoisier VS and Grand Marnier, and is served up with a sugar rim and orange peel.
method: Rim a chilled coupe with sugar (run a lemon or orange wedge around the edge, then dip in sugar).
Shake the cognac, Grand Marnier, and lemon juice with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the rimmed coupe.
garnish: Sugar rim and an orange peel, expressed over the drink

name: Sumptuous Sidecar
ingredients: Rémy Martin 1738 (premium Sidecar), Grand Marnier, lemon juice, orange peel, sugar rim
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu lists only Rémy Martin 1738 as a premium Sidecar, so this uses the same Grand Marnier, lemon, sugar rim, and orange peel as the house Sidecar, with 1738 in place of Courvoisier VS.
method: Rim a chilled coupe with sugar.
Shake the Rémy Martin 1738, Grand Marnier, and lemon juice with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the rimmed coupe.
garnish: Sugar rim and an orange peel, expressed over the drink

name: Fancy Old Fashioned
ingredients: Bulleit rye whiskey, Luxardo cherry, simple syrup, Angostura bitters, orange peel
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Stir the rye, simple syrup, and Angostura with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain over one big cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the drink and drop it in with the Luxardo cherry.
garnish: Orange peel and a Luxardo cherry

name: Sazerac
ingredients: Michter's rye whiskey, absinthe, Peychaud's bitters, simple syrup, lemon peel
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. This bar's Sazerac is all Michter's rye (no cognac split) and is served up.
method: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe and discard the excess.
Stir the rye, simple syrup, and Peychaud's with ice for 20–30 seconds.
Strain into the rinsed coupe.
garnish: Lemon peel, expressed over the drink and dropped in or perched on the rim

name: Smash & Grab
ingredients: Larceny bourbon, simple syrup, mint, flat water, lemon juice, shaved ice
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.

recipe.item: shaved ice, to pack the glass

method: In a shaker, gently press the mint with the simple syrup — don't shred the leaves.
Add the bourbon and lemon juice, then shake briefly with a little ice.
Pack a rocks glass with shaved ice (crushed ice is fine if you don't have a shaver).
Strain over the shaved ice, top with the flat water, and swizzle once to mix.
Add more shaved ice to mound the top.
garnish: A fresh mint sprig, slapped to wake up the aroma

name: Paloma
ingredients: Espolon silver tequila, lime, grapefruit soda
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Jarritos grapefruit, Squirt, or fresh grapefruit juice topped with soda all work.
method: Build the tequila and lime over ice in a rocks glass.
Top with grapefruit soda and give it a short, gentle stir.
garnish: A lime wheel or wedge

name: Mully Pom Cider
ingredients: Ginger liqueur, pomegranate juice, mulled cranberry syrup, orange, Molley Chomper hard cider
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Molley Chomper is a North Carolina hard cider; a dry local cider can stand in. Domaine de Canton or another ginger liqueur works for the ginger.

recipe.item: ginger liqueur (Domaine de Canton or similar)
Molley Chomper hard cider (or a dry hard cider)

method: Mulled cranberry syrup: simmer 1 cup cranberry juice (or 1 cup cranberries plus 1/2 cup water) with 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, and a strip of orange peel for about 10 minutes. Strain and cool.
Build the ginger liqueur, pomegranate juice, and mulled cranberry syrup over ice in a rocks glass.
Top with the hard cider and stir once.
garnish: An orange wheel or a wide orange peel

name: Fig Gin Punch
ingredients: Sutler's gin, fig molasses, cream, orange bitters, whipped cream, grated nutmeg, shaved ice
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Sutler's gin is a North Carolina gin; a floral London dry can stand in. Fig molasses is house-made — see the method.

recipe.item: shaved ice, to pack the glass

method: Fig molasses: simmer 4 chopped dried figs (or 3 tbsp fig jam) with 2 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp brown sugar, and 1/2 cup water until the fruit is soft and the liquid is thick and syrupy, about 10 minutes. Mash, strain, and cool. Keeps a week in the fridge.
Shake the gin, fig molasses, cream, and orange bitters with ice for 15 seconds.
Pack a rocks glass with shaved ice and strain the drink over it.
Top with a spoonful of lightly whipped cream and grate nutmeg over the top.
garnish: Whipped cream and freshly grated nutmeg

name: Cran Royale
ingredients: Crown Royal, Reed's ginger beer, mulled cranberry syrup, orange peel
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec.
method: Mulled cranberry syrup: simmer 1 cup cranberry juice (or 1 cup cranberries plus 1/2 cup water) with 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, and a strip of orange peel for about 10 minutes. Strain and cool.
Build the Crown Royal and mulled cranberry syrup over ice in a rocks glass.
Top with Reed's ginger beer and stir once.
garnish: An orange peel, expressed over the drink

name: Spicy Bloody Mary
ingredients: SSG signature mix, vodka, olive, pepperoncini
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. The menu also sells an SSG Bloody Mary Mix Bottle as a retail item — that's a mix to take home, not a drink on this list. SSG is likely the restaurant group. The house mix below stands in if you don't have the bottle.

recipe.item: SSG signature Bloody Mary mix (or the house mix below)

method: If you don't have the SSG mix, stir 1 cup tomato juice with 1/2 oz lemon juice, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 1/2 tsp prepared horseradish, a few dashes of hot sauce, a pinch of celery salt and black pepper, and a splash of pickle brine if you have it. Chill. For more heat, add a pinch of cayenne or a slice of fresh jalapeño.
Build the vodka and mix over ice in a rocks glass and stir.
garnish: An olive and a pepperoncini

name: Spiced Pear Martini
ingredients: Grey Goose pear vodka, pear juice, Muddy River spiced rum, spiced syrup, lemon juice
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Muddy River is a North Carolina rum distillery. Grey Goose La Poire is the pear vodka; any pear vodka can stand in.
method: Spiced syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 2 allspice berries, and a thin slice of fresh ginger for about 8 minutes. Strain and cool.
Shake the pear vodka, pear juice, spiced rum, spiced syrup, and lemon juice with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
garnish: A thin pear slice, or a cinnamon stick

name: Lemon Blossom
ingredients: Tensei 'Endless Summer' sake, limoncello, orange blossom water, yuzu, lavender & lemon sugar rim
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Tensei 'Endless Summer' is a junmai sake; another light, citrusy junmai can stand in. Go easy on the orange blossom water — a little goes a long way. Bottled yuzu juice is fine if you can't find fresh yuzu.

recipe.item: Tensei 'Endless Summer' sake (or a light junmai)

method: Lavender-lemon sugar rim: stir 2 tbsp sugar with 1/2 tsp crushed dried culinary lavender and the zest of 1 lemon. Run a lemon wedge around a chilled coupe and dip the rim in the sugar.
Shake the sake, limoncello, yuzu, and orange blossom water with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the rimmed coupe.
garnish: Lavender-lemon sugar rim, and a thin lemon twist if you like

name: Purple Gimlet
ingredients: Conniption Kinship gin, lime juice, elderflower liqueur, simple syrup
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Conniption Kinship is a North Carolina gin from Durham Distillery; a floral gin can stand in. St-Germain or another elderflower liqueur works here.
method: Shake the gin, lime juice, elderflower liqueur, and simple syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
garnish: A thin lime wheel, or no garnish

name: Large Marge
ingredients: Tres Agaves reposado tequila, Grand Marnier, key lime syrup, house sour, lime, salt
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. Key lime syrup and house sour are house-made — see the method. Regular lime juice can stand in for key lime if needed.
method: Key lime syrup: stir 1/2 cup key lime juice (or regular lime juice) with 1/2 cup sugar and a strip of lime zest until the sugar dissolves; or warm it gently, then cool and pull the zest.
House sour: stir together 1 oz fresh lemon juice, 1 oz fresh lime juice, and 1 oz simple syrup. This batch covers a few drinks; use 1 oz in this one.
Rim a chilled coupe with salt (run a lime wedge around the edge, then dip in kosher salt).
Shake the tequila, Grand Marnier, key lime syrup, and house sour with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the salted coupe.
garnish: Salt rim and a lime wheel

name: Whiplashes
ingredients: Shanky's Whip caramel & vanilla black Irish whiskey, vanilla bean syrup, Bald Guy coffee elixir, whipped cream, butterscotch
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Shanky's Whip is a caramel-and-vanilla black Irish whiskey liqueur. Bald Guy is a coffee brand — if you can't find the elixir, use a concentrated cold brew or a coffee liqueur.

recipe.item: Shanky's Whip (caramel & vanilla black Irish whiskey)
Bald Guy coffee elixir (or strong cold brew / coffee liqueur)

method: Vanilla bean syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 1 split vanilla bean for about 5 minutes (or stir 1 tsp vanilla extract into 1/2 cup simple syrup off the heat). Cool; leave the bean in the bottle if you used one.
Shake the Shanky's Whip, vanilla bean syrup, and coffee elixir with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Top with a spoonful of lightly whipped cream and drizzle a little butterscotch sauce over it.
garnish: Whipped cream and a butterscotch drizzle

name: Candied Coffee
ingredients: Bushmills Irish whiskey, praline cream liqueur, vanilla bean syrup, cream, Bald Guy coffee, whipped cream
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu marks this (NC) — it features North Carolina artisan spirits or products. Served hot, like an Irish coffee. If you'd rather have it cold, shake everything with ice and strain into a coupe. A praline or butterscotch cream liqueur works; if you can't find one, use 1/2 oz Irish cream plus 1/4 oz butterscotch schnapps. Bald Guy coffee can be swapped for any strong hot coffee.

recipe.item: hot Bald Guy coffee (or strong hot coffee)

method: Vanilla bean syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 1 split vanilla bean for about 5 minutes (or stir 1 tsp vanilla extract into 1/2 cup simple syrup off the heat). Cool.
Warm a mug, then add the Bushmills, praline cream liqueur, vanilla bean syrup, and cream.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Float a spoonful of lightly whipped cream on top.
garnish: Whipped cream

name: Earl of Fog
ingredients: Earl Grey tea, gin, crème de violette, honey syrup, hot water, cream, orange twist
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. A hot tea cocktail in the London Fog family. The menu doesn't name a gin; a London dry works well with Earl Grey and violette.
method: Honey syrup: stir equal parts honey and hot water until the honey dissolves, then cool slightly.
Steep a strong cup of Earl Grey (one bag or a heaping teaspoon of loose tea in about 5 oz just-off-boil water for 3–4 minutes) and use 4 oz of it.
Warm a mug, then add the gin, crème de violette, and honey syrup.
Pour in the hot tea and stir. Float or slowly pour the cream on top.
garnish: An orange twist, expressed over the mug

name: Hot Toddy
ingredients: Bourbon, Angostura bitters, lemon, honey syrup, hot water
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. The menu doesn't name a bourbon; use whatever you already like in a toddy.
method: Honey syrup: stir equal parts honey and hot water until the honey dissolves.
Warm a mug, then add the bourbon, Angostura, lemon juice, and honey syrup.
Top with hot water and stir.
garnish: A lemon wheel, or a lemon twist

name: Soused Snow Cream
ingredients: Vanilla bean vodka, vanilla bean syrup, shaved ice, cream, whipped cream, nutmeg
notes: Home recipe — our version, not the bar's official spec. A boozy snow-cream dessert you eat with a spoon. Any vanilla vodka works if you don't have a vanilla-bean one; crushed ice is fine if you can't shave it.

recipe.item: shaved ice, to mound the glass

method: Vanilla bean syrup: simmer 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water with 1 split vanilla bean for about 5 minutes (or stir 1 tsp vanilla extract into 1/2 cup simple syrup off the heat). Cool.
Shake the vanilla vodka, vanilla bean syrup, and cream with ice for 10 seconds.
Pack a rocks glass with a mound of shaved ice and pour the drink over it.
Top with a spoonful of lightly whipped cream and grate nutmeg over the top. Serve with a spoon.
garnish: Whipped cream, freshly grated nutmeg, and a spoon
